# Dev Toolbox

Canonical URL: https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/

Dev Toolbox is an open-source, offline-first developer toolbox. All tools run locally in your browser. The application does not upload your input, use tracking, show ads, or set cookies.

## Tool Categories

- Productivity: Time management and focus.
- Cryptography: Encoding, hashing, and verification.
- Time: Dates, timestamps, and zones.
- Number: Bases, bits, and permissions.
- Graphics: Images, colors, and QR.
- Network: Requests and API tooling.
- Misc: Grab bag utilities.

## Tools

- [Pomodoro](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/pomodoro/): Focus timer with configurable work and break cycles. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [Cron Tab Helper + Visualizer](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/cron/): Build cron expressions and preview upcoming runs. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [Levenshtein Distance Calculator](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/levenshtein/): Compare strings and compute edit distance. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [URI Encoder / Decoder](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/uri/): Encode or decode URI components safely. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [HTML Encoder / Decoder](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/html/): Escape or decode HTML entities. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [Base64 Encoder / Decoder](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/base64/): Convert text or binary to base64 and back. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [MD5 Hasher](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/hashers/): Generate MD5 hashes for strings or files. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [JWT Helper](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/jwt/): Validate tokens, import JWKs, and manage clock skew. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [Hash Verifier](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/hash-verifier/): Check hashes against known values. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [HMAC Generator](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/hmac/): Generate HMAC signatures with SHA-256/SHA-512. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [SSH Key Fingerprint](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/ssh-fingerprint/): Compute MD5 or SHA-256 fingerprints for SSH keys. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [TLS Certificate Decoder](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/tls-cert/): Decode PEM certificates locally. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [Timestamp to Time](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/timestamp/): Convert Unix timestamps to readable dates. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [Timezone Converter](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/timezone/): Convert times across timezones. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [Relative Time Calculator](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/relative-time/): Compute relative durations and offsets. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [Change Base Helper](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/base/): Convert numbers between bases. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [IPv4 Helper](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/ipv4/): Work with IPv4 addresses and CIDR. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [Binary Helper](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/binary/): Convert and inspect binary values. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [Unix Permission Calculator](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/unix-permissions/): Translate chmod values to symbolic permissions. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [Image Helper](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/image-helper/): Resize, compress, and convert images. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [Color Picker](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/color-picker/): Pick colors and copy values. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [Color Shades Generator](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/color-shades/): Generate tints and shades for a palette. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [QR Code Generator + Reader](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/qr/): Create or scan QR codes. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [Color Contrast Checker](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/color-contrast/): Check WCAG contrast ratios. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [Image Metadata Viewer](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/image-metadata/): Read EXIF/IPTC metadata from images. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [URL Parser](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/url-parser/): Parse URLs into structured components. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [OpenAPI/Swagger Viewer](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/openapi/): Preview OpenAPI specs with a local viewer. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [ASCII Reference Table](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/ascii-table/): Lookup ASCII codes and characters. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [Help me I'm stuck in Vim!](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/vim-help/): Quick exit cheatsheet for Vim. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [File Diff + Patch Viewer](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/diff-viewer/): Compare files and preview patch application. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [Lorem Ipsum Generator](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/lorem-ipsum/): Generate placeholder text blocks. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [JSON Formatter/Minifier + JSONPath](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/json/): Format JSON, minify, and query with JSONPath. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [YAML ↔ JSON Converter](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/yaml-json/): Convert YAML to JSON and back. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [CSV ↔ JSON Converter](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/csv-json/): Convert CSV to JSON and back. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [XML Formatter + XPath Tester](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/xml/): Format XML and evaluate XPath queries. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [UUID/ULID/KSUID Generator](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/id-generator/): Generate sortable and random IDs. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [Regex Tester + Explainer](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/regex/): Test regex patterns and explain matches. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [Text Case Converter + Slugify](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/text-case/): Convert text case and generate slugs. Works offline with local browser processing.
- [Base-N Encoders](https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/tools/base-n-encoders/): Encode data in Base32, Base58, or Base85. Works offline with local browser processing.

## Crawling Notes

Sitemap: https://dtdg.fr/dev-toolbox/sitemap.xml
Pages are statically generated. Interactive processing happens in the browser; user input is not sent to the server.
